top_jobs.job: When a test passes its end date or wins, help me make the call on the rule we set and get the winner live for every shopper, so I stop paying for the losing version and bank the win
top_jobs.metric: days from each test's planned read date to a recorded result, and share of winners live on 100 percent of traffic within 14 days

top_jobs.job: When someone proposes an idea or a new marketer starts, help me see what this store already tried, what won, what failed and why, so we never pay for the same answer twice
top_jobs.metric: tests launched that repeat a past idea with no new reason written, per quarter

top_jobs.job: When a test is about to go live, help me write the win rule, the orders it needs and the read date, and check the setup, so the result cannot be spun or spoiled
top_jobs.metric: share of tests launched with metric, read date, stop rule and scale rule on file

top_jobs.job: When the queue has 20 ideas and room for 2, help me pick the ones aimed at the biggest profit leak and judge every result on profit per visitor, so our few test slots go where the money is
top_jobs.metric: share of tests launched from the top 5 of the ranked list, per quarter

jobs.job: Every Monday, list tests past their read date with no result, read each against its written rule, and record win, loss, flat or unreadable with the number
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: running tests with read date and rule
orders, revenue and sessions per version

steps: List every test whose read date has passed and has no result
Pull each version's visitors, orders, gross profit and guardrail metric
Compare with the rule written before launch
Mark win, loss, flat or unreadable, naming the missing field if unreadable
Founder confirms each call in the Monday meeting
Stop the losing version the same day
jobs.output: a Monday read list: each test with the call, the number and the rule it was judged on
jobs.next: feeds 25-02 (promote wins), 25-03 (fail notes) and 26-05 (tests in the weekly pack)

watch.metric: days from each test's planned read date to a recorded result

jobs.job: Promote each win to the T0 standard: write the rule it proves (for example 'first frame shows the product in use'), the proof, where it applies, and a recheck date 90 days out
jobs.trigger: the day a test is called a win

inputs.need: the ad or page tags that changed

steps: Name the one change that won in plain words
Write it as a standard all new work starts from, with the proof and the scope (product, channel, awareness level)
Match it to the principle it followed from the idea bank
Set the recheck date and the number that would retire it
Send the new standard to the brief builders on creative, copy and landing pages
jobs.output: a T0 standard: rule, proof, scope, principle and recheck date
jobs.next: feeds 09 (creative briefs), 10 (copy) and 07 (landing pages); rechecked in 25-11

watch.metric: share of wins turned into a written standard within 7 days

jobs.drives: win rate of new work built on standards

jobs.job: For each loss, write a fail note: what we tried, the number, the likely why, what it rules out, and the date or condition to retest
jobs.trigger: the day a test is called a loss or flat

inputs.need: who saw it and where people dropped, for ad losses
the test card with the hypothesis

steps: State the idea and the result in 2 lines
Name the likely why from the drop-off data, not a guess
Write what it rules out and what it does not
Set a retest date or condition, like a new season or a new price
Tag it so any similar proposal shows this note
jobs.output: a fail note with the why, what it rules out and a retest date

watch.metric: closed tests with a written lesson

jobs.job: 14 days after each call, check the winner is live on 100 percent of traffic, the loser is off, and the win holds on phones as well as desktop
jobs.trigger: 14 days after every called win

inputs.need: live page, theme and ad versions
the call and the winning version

steps: Check the live page or ad matches the winning version
Check the test tool is off and the loser is gone
Split the result by phone and desktop
If phones lost, open a follow-up test for phones only
Mark the win shipped with a date
jobs.output: a shipped check per win: live, loser off, phone and desktop result
jobs.next: feeds 26-20 (what each change moved at month close)

watch.metric: share of called winners live on 100 percent of traffic within 14 days

jobs.job: Audit every win above 20 percent before rollout: split within 1 point of plan, purchases counted in both versions, no sale in the window, and no bot spike
jobs.trigger: before rolling out any win above 20 percent

inputs.need: sessions by source, country and hour, to spot bot spikes

steps: Check the split ratio against plan
Check orders per version in GA4 match store orders
Check the window for sales, launches, emails and bot spikes
Mark the win clean or suspect
Rerun suspect wins for 2 more weeks
jobs.output: a clean or suspect mark on every big win, with the reason

watch.metric: share of wins above 20 percent checked before rollout

jobs.job: Read every Meta ad test with the same rules as a site test: spend per version set before launch, cost per new customer as the metric, and a 7 day read
jobs.trigger: at launch and at the read date of every ad test

inputs.need: ad results per version: spend, purchases, new customers, age, gender, placement
new versus returning buyers from the store

steps: Write the card before launch: versions, spend each, metric, read date
At the read, pull spend and results per version
Judge on cost per new customer, not clicks or platform ROAS alone
Check the top segment per version from the age, gender and placement split
Record the call in the ledger
jobs.output: an ad test read with the call, the segment where it won, and the ledger entry

watch.metric: share of ad tests read against a rule set before launch

jobs.job: Load every past test from sheets, Slack and agency decks into one registry with hypothesis, dates, versions, result and lesson, marking missing fields as unknown
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then every closed test adds a row

inputs.need: past test notes, sheets and agency decks

steps: Collect every past test file and deck
Write one row per test: idea, dates, versions, metric, result, lesson
Mark unknown fields as unknown, never guessed
Tag each by area, page, awareness level and idea type
Founder reads the 10 biggest rows and fixes what is wrong
Write a 1 page 'what we know' per area for any new marketer
jobs.output: a registry of past tests and a 1 page 'what we know' per area

watch.metric: areas with a decision history updated in the last 90 days

jobs.job: Turn each creative postmortem into a registry entry: the ad, spend, who saw it, where people dropped, the cause and the fix, tagged so the next brief sees it
jobs.trigger: every time an ad is killed after $200 or more spend

inputs.need: ad spend, reach, age, gender, placement, hook and hold rates
landing page conversion for the ad's traffic

steps: Pull the ad's numbers and the segments that saw it
Find the step where people dropped: thumb stop, hold, click, page or cart
Write the likely cause and the fix
Relaunch with the fix, or kill it with a note
File it in the ledger with tags so any brief with the same tags shows it
jobs.output: a postmortem entry per killed ad, with the fix or a kill note, tagged

watch.metric: killed ads with a postmortem on file

jobs.drives: spend on repeats of failed creative

jobs.job: Check every new test proposal against the registry and the idea bank by tags, and show the 3 closest past tests with results before it goes on the queue
jobs.trigger: whenever anyone proposes a test
steps: Tag the proposal: area, page, lever, awareness level
Find the 3 closest past tests and the closest idea bank entries
Show results and fail notes next to the proposal
Ask for a new reason if it repeats a past loss
Queue, change or drop it
jobs.output: a proposal card with 3 past tests and a go, change or drop call

watch.metric: tests launched that repeat a past idea with no new reason written

jobs.drives: test money spent on known answers

jobs.job: Test the principle behind each ad winner on a second product or format, and mark it 'holds for this brand' or 'does not' after 2 reads
jobs.trigger: after each win promoted to T0

inputs.need: a second product or format to try it on

steps: Name the principle the winner followed
Build 1 new ad on a second product or format that keeps the principle
Run it as an ad test with the same read rules
Mark the principle holds or does not after 2 reads
Update the brand's principle list
jobs.output: a list of principles marked proven, not proven or failed for this brand

watch.metric: principles with 2 reads on file

jobs.job: Each month, pull T0 standards past their recheck date, check them against the last 90 days of numbers, and keep, retire or retest each
jobs.trigger: the first Monday of each month, and each quarter for shipped winners

inputs.need: standards with recheck date and retire rule
the metric each standard moved, last 90 days
inputs.from: store platform, GA4 and Meta Ads

steps: List standards past their recheck date
Pull the metric each one moved, last 90 days against the proof
Keep, retire or retest each
Set the next recheck date
Tell the screens that use a retired standard
jobs.output: a monthly recheck list: kept, retired, retest, with dates

watch.metric: shipped winners still live and still ahead at 90 days

jobs.job: Run the same 20 minute look-back after each launch, replatform, big sale or crisis, with 5 fixed questions, and file the answers
jobs.trigger: within 7 days after each launch, big sale, replatform or crisis

inputs.need: sales, profit and tickets for the window

steps: Ask: what did we plan, what happened, what went well, what went wrong, what we do next time
Pull the numbers for the window
Write 3 changes for next time
Add the changes to the checklist for the next launch
File the look-back
jobs.output: a look-back note with 3 changes added to the next launch checklist

watch.metric: big projects closed with a look-back on file

jobs.job: Bring parked ideas back when their reason runs out, like stock landing or the busy season ending, with the original note and the numbers since
jobs.trigger: weekly check of return dates and conditions

inputs.need: parked ideas with a return date or condition

steps: List parked ideas whose date passed or condition is met
Attach the original note and what changed
Founder decides: queue, park again with a new date, or drop
jobs.output: a list of returning ideas with a new call each

watch.metric: parked ideas past their return date with no new decision

jobs.job: Write a test card before launch: hypothesis, primary metric (gross profit per visitor), guardrail, orders needed per version, read date, stop rule and scale rule, signed by the founder
jobs.trigger: before every test

inputs.need: the idea and the page, ad or email
traffic and conversion on the page

steps: Write the hypothesis: if we change X, Y moves because Z
Pick gross profit per visitor as the main metric, and a guardrail like return rate
Compute orders needed and the read date
Write the stop rule and the scale rule
Founder signs; no sign, no launch
jobs.output: a signed test card on file for every test

watch.metric: share of tests launched with metric, read date, stop rule and scale rule on file

jobs.job: Compute the orders and days each test needs from the page's traffic and conversion rate, and turn down any test that cannot finish in 6 weeks, offering a bolder change instead
jobs.trigger: before every test, and when planning the month

inputs.need: weekly visitors and orders on the page

steps: Pull weekly visitors and conversion rate for the page
Compute orders per version for the smallest lift worth finding
Turn it into days
If over 6 weeks, suggest a bolder change or a bigger page
Set how many tests the store can carry this month
jobs.output: a sample size and days per test, and the month's test capacity

watch.metric: share of tests that reached their planned orders by the read date

jobs.drives: tests that end in a clear call

jobs.job: Before launch, check no other test shares the page area, audience or dates, and no sale, holiday or launch falls in the window, then check purchases count in both versions on day 1
jobs.trigger: before every launch and on day 1

inputs.need: running tests with pages, audiences and dates

steps: List running tests that share the page area or audience
Check the calendar for sales and launches in the window
Move the date or mark the read
On day 1, check orders show in both versions and the split is within 1 point
Pause and fix if either fails
jobs.output: a launch check passed or failed, with the clash or setup fault named

watch.metric: share of tests that passed a launch check

jobs.drives: test windows lost to broken setups

jobs.job: Duplicate the live theme, make the speed or checkout flow change on the copy, walk the checkout on 3 phones, test both, and merge only after the read
jobs.trigger: for every theme, speed or checkout change

inputs.need: the live theme and a copy

steps: Duplicate the live theme
Make the change on the copy only
Test speed on both, and walk checkout on 3 phones
Split traffic or run a timed switch, with a test card
Merge the copy only if it wins; log the result either way
jobs.output: a tested theme copy merged or dropped, with the speed and conversion numbers

watch.metric: conversion rate and revenue per visitor, copy against live

jobs.drives: site changes that do not break checkout

jobs.job: Rank the test queue each month by money at stake (visitors on the page, times the gap to a benchmark, times margin) and pick the top 2, sending clear defects straight to a fix
jobs.trigger: the first Monday of each month

inputs.need: the proposal queue with past-test checks
idea bank ideas/v1 filtered by the brand's bottleneck

steps: Score each proposal by money at stake
Move clear defects like a broken button to a fix card, no test
Take the top 2 that fit the month's capacity
Founder approves
Park the rest with a return date
jobs.output: a ranked queue with 2 picks, a defect fix list, and parked ideas

watch.metric: share of tests launched from the top 5 of the ranked list

jobs.job: Keep a 5 percent held-back group away from popups, win-back discounts and new apps, and compare orders and gross profit per person over 30 and 90 days
jobs.trigger: set up once, read monthly and before any app renewal

inputs.need: customers and visitors with a held-back flag
orders and gross profit per person

steps: Pick 5 percent of visitors and subscribers at random and flag them
Exclude them from popups, discounts and the new app
Compare orders and gross profit per person after 30 and 90 days
Keep, cut or change each tactic on the number
Show the whole program's gain against the held-back group
jobs.output: a held-back read per tactic, and the program's gain in dollars

watch.metric: orders and gross profit per person, shown the offer against held back

jobs.drives: discounts paid to people who would buy anyway

jobs.job: 30 days after each win, compare returns, refunds and tickets from each version's buyers, and demote the win if gross profit per visitor flipped
jobs.trigger: 30 days after every called win

inputs.need: orders per version with returns and refunds

steps: Pull each version's buyers
Count returns, refunds and tickets per 100 orders
Recompute gross profit per visitor after returns
Keep the win or demote it with a fail note
jobs.output: a 30 day check per win: kept or demoted, with the numbers

watch.metric: return rate and refund rate of each version's buyers

jobs.drives: wins that stay wins after returns

new_enablers.name: Test card and queue
new_enablers.what: A card written before every test: hypothesis, main metric, guardrail, orders needed, read date, stop and scale rules, founder sign-off. Holds the ranked queue, the sample size math and a check for clashes with other tests and the calendar.

new_enablers.name: Decision log
new_enablers.what: Every decision with date, owner, why, the number it should move and a review date. Holds parked ideas with a return condition and project look-backs.
